Description.Name: Nobility Line
Description.Details:
Darius turns your attention to the message on the screen, "This was sent to us from an unknown source."

"An Unknown Source?", you ask.

"It appears they bounced the message off another HPG relay, Sumire is trying to triangulate it but she's not having much luck."

Dr. Murad interjects, "The signal is audio only. I confirmed that it is safe Commander."

You raise an eyebrow, "Well, as long as the message isn't threatening, I can't see the harm in checking it out."

Darius nods, "Playing back the message right now."

Description.Name: Continue
Description.Details: The scratchy audio begins to play. "This message is intended for the mercenary unit that owns a rather unique dropship. In a short time, your exploits have attracted the attention of not only the Inner Sphere factions but that of the entire Rimward Periphery." A curious grin crawls along your face as you listen on. "We are aware how hard it is to get ahead in this galaxy. Seeing as you are trying to grow your outfit, we chose to volunteer 250 tonnes of heavy metal...if you're interested." Darius pauses the message and turns to you, "This is where it takes a weird turn." After a brief awkward silence, the message continues. "In short, if you want them then you'll have to go out and get them yourself, one by one, as they are scattered throughout the Periphery. First, head to the New Roland system. With the coordinates we've provided, you will find your first mech. That, in turn, will lead you to the next mech and so on and so forth." The message ends aburptly, leaving you wondering if it's a trap or not. "I don't know about everyone here but I'm up for a little scavenger hunt.", Yang smiles. You nod in agreement, "Well, it can't hurt to look when we are in the area. We can always scout ahead with the Leopard." Sumire nods as everyone returns to their duties.
